title: Tiropita: Greek Feta and Filo Cheese Pie
summary: A golden, shatteringly crisp filo pie with a tangy filling of feta, nutty graviera and cottage cheese set with egg, baked in a square tin and cut into nine.

ingredients.item: feta in brine, drained and crumbled
graviera or alpine-style hard cheese (microbial rennet), coarsely grated
filo sheets, about 35 x 23 cm, thawed
ingredients.note: about 300 g; cut larger sheets to fit

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Mix the feta, graviera, cottage cheese, eggs, cornflour, mint and pepper in a bowl. The cornflour holds the moisture from the cheeses, so the filling sets creamy rather than weeping.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Put a rack in the lowest position of the oven and heat it to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Line the tin with two crossed strips of foil that overhang the sides, then brush it with butter. Cover the filo with a damp tea towel so it does not dry out and crack.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Lay in 8 filo sheets one at a time, brushing each with butter and turning each a quarter turn from the last so the overhang falls on all four sides. The butter between the layers fries them into crisp flakes in the oven.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spread the filling evenly over the base, right into the corners.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Layer 8 more sheets over the filling in the same way, brushing each one with butter.

steps.title: Seal
steps.text: Pinch the overhanging edges together and roll them inwards to make a thick rim, then brush the top and rim with the rest of the butter. Cut through the top layers into 9 squares without cutting the base; pre-cutting stops the crisp top shattering when you serve.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 25-30 minutes, until deep golden and crisp and the centre of the filling reads 71 °C. Heat from the low rack crisps the base so it does not go soggy.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Lift the pie out on the foil onto a rack, slide the foil away and leave for 30 minutes. As it cools the filling firms up, so the squares cut cleanly; cut along the marks and serve warm.

tips: Letting the filo dry out is the common mistake; keep the sheets covered and work steadily.
Torn sheets are fine in the middle layers, so save the best ones for the top.
Drain the feta well so the filling is not wet.
Bake until deep golden; pale filo is soft and greasy.
storage: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat at 180 °C for 10-12 minutes, until piping hot and crisp again. Freeze the unbaked pie, well wrapped, for up to 1 month and bake from frozen, adding 10-15 minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
